question: Which of the five has been most explicit about serving mass-affluent clients, and what exactly have they said?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James launched a Private Wealth Advisor designation program, launched in September 2022, which provides training, coaching, and a peer network for advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients, generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets.
items.quote: the firm's Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation program, launched in September 2022, which provides training, coaching, and a peer network for advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets.
items.definition: high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets

items.text: Raymond James commits to being a destination for private wealth advisors and their clients, stating individuals and families with significant wealth require personal advice, and that Private Wealth Guided Portfolios help advisors serve high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients.
items.quote: At Raymond James, we're committed to being a destination for private wealth advisors and the clients they serve. Individuals and families with significant wealth require truly personal advice, backed by the right resources...

items.text: Raymond James' private wealth advisor program and expanded alternative investments platform supports advisors who focus on high-net-worth clients.
items.quote: our private wealth advisor program and expanded alternative investments platform supports advisors who focus on high-net-worth clients.

items.text: In the private wealth space, Raymond James remains focused on providing education, training, accreditation, and enhanced capabilities and product solutions to allow advisors to meet the needs of their most sophisticated clients.
items.quote: in the private wealth space, we remain focused on providing education, training, accreditation, and enhanced capabilities and product solutions to allow advisors to meet the needs of their most sophisticated clients.

items.text: Raymond James introduces Private Wealth Guided Portfolios for financial advisors serving high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients, integrating traditional and alternative investments.
items.quote: Raymond James Financial has introduced Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, which integrate traditional and alternative investments within risk-based portfolios for financial advisors serving high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients, the firm said.

items.text: Raymond James offers Wealth Strategies to bring the best of the firm to high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients for independent RIAs.
items.quote: Wealth Strategies: Bring the best of our firm to your high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients

cells.reason: Multiple passages describe Raymond James explicitly targeting high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients (which includes the mass-affluent/affluent segment) through its private wealth program and offerings, but none use the specific term 'mass-affluent'; these are the closest explicit statements about targeting affluent clients.
